title: LangChain: Multi-Agent Handoff
description: Two differently-prompted ChatOllama models where clarifier's output becomes executor's entire context, ensuring clean separation.

steps.description: Handoff pattern: clarifier creates a brief, executor fulfills it with only that brief as context.
Model instances: two ChatOllama models with different temperatures.
Question: the user's vague request to summarize why local models matter.
Agent 1: clarifier with SystemMessage to rewrite request as precise brief, HumanMessage with the question.
Handoff: executor's ENTIRE context is clarifier's output, with its own SystemMessage and the brief as HumanMessage.
